mechanism_narrative: A current federal funds rate above 5.0% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as observed in historical monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in unemployment rate over three months signals deteriorating labor market health, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE rises by >0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) and tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5%) trigger aggressive monetary policy expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as equity valuations adjust to higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 5.0 and UNRATE < 3.5.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days as the market anticipates rate hikes to curb inflation.
failure_condition: In FEDFUNDS > 4.5% periods, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of CPIAUCSL > 5.0 instances.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS > 700,000 million dollars) signals robust consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when RSAFS > 700000.

mechanism_narrative: A 2.0% decline in industrial production over three months signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as supply chain disruptions reduce corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls by >2.0% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high retail sales (RSAFS > 700,000) and high housing starts (HOUST > 1,400,000 units) signal broad-based consumer and housing demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through sector-wide earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 700000 and HOUST > 1400.

mechanism_narrative: During supply shocks (INDPRO < 95.0), high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as stagflation risks increase market volatility and reduce risk appetite.
failure_condition: In INDPRO < 95.0 periods, SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of CPIAUCSL > 5.0 instances.
